sources.title: Git repository history and default branch
sources.supports: Baseline commit 711ff12 (2026-09-09); branches feat/shak, feat-shak and codex/production-source-maintenance-20261027 (2026-10-26).

sources.title: endoflife.date Node.js
sources.supports: Node 18 security support ended 2025-04-30; Node 26 active support to 2027-10-27, security to 2029-04-30.

sources.title: endoflife.date MySQL
sources.supports: MySQL 5.7 extended support ended 2023-10-31; 8.0 ended 2026-04-30; 8.4 LTS premier to 2029-04-30.

sources.title: npm registry package metadata (versions, engines, dist-tags)
sources.supports: Versions used in data/dependencies.json; next@16.4.6 engines node>=20.9.0; express latest 5.3.0 / latest-4 4.22.3.

sources.title: npm audit advisories for this repository
sources.url: local `npm audit --omit=dev` in api/, bot/, dashboard/
sources.supports: api 14 vulnerabilities (3 critical, 7 high); bot 9 (1 critical, 6 high); dashboard 4 (1 critical, 3 high).

sources.title: Discord embed limits
sources.supports: title 256, description 4096, field name 256, field value 1024, max 25 fields, 6000 characters across a message.

sources.title: Discord rate limits
sources.supports: Bots may make 50 requests/second globally; 401/403/429 responses count toward a 10,000 per 10 minutes invalid-request limit.

sources.title: Discord MESSAGE_CONTENT intent warning
sources.supports: Content, embeds, attachments and components are empty unless the privileged MESSAGE_CONTENT intent is approved.

sources.title: Next.js route segment config
sources.supports: Route-level caching/dynamic configuration; in v16 the dynamic/revalidate options are removed when Cache Components is enabled, so behaviour must be verified per version.

sources.title: Hetzner Cloud pricing
sources.supports: Regular Performance cloud servers from EUR 5.49/month excluding VAT; used only as the low-cost scenario.

sources.title: Executed baseline probes
sources.supports: API, bot handler, build and browser observations on main@711ff12 with MySQL 8.0 and Node 22.23.1.
